import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier
import os

# Set environment variable to disable progress bars
os.environ["LC_MESSAGES"] = "C"
os.environ["PYTHONWARNINGS"] = ""

# Load datasets
train_df = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")

# Extract IDs from training set for reference
train_ids = train_df["id"].values
test_ids = test_df["id"].values

# Prepare feature columns (exclude id, target columns)
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["id", "target"]]

# Handle categorical feature f_27
cat_col_idx = list(feature_cols).index("f_27") if "f_27" in feature_cols else None
if cat_col_idx is not None:
    # One-hot encode the categorical feature
    df_train_encoded = train_df.copy()
    df_test_encoded = test_df.copy()

    # Use le Label Encoder for categorical feature
    from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder

    le = LabelEncoder()

    # Fit on train and transform both
    df_train_encoded[f"f_27_enc"] = le.fit_transform(train_df["f_27"])
    df_test_encoded[f"f_27_enc"] = le.transform(test_df["f_27"])

    # Replace original f_27 with encoded version and drop original
    df_train_encoded = df_train_encoded.drop(["f_27"], axis=1)
    df_test_encoded = df_test_encoded.drop(["f_27"], axis=1)

    X_train = df_train_encoded[feature_cols].values
    y_train = train_df["target"].values
    X_test = df_test_encoded[feature_cols].values

else:
    X_train = train_df[feature_cols].values
    y_train = train_df["target"].values
    X_test = test_df[feature_cols].values

# Split into validation and training set for evaluation
X_train_full, X_val, y_train_full, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Train LightGBM model
model = LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=500,
    max_depth=10,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=31,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0,
    reg_lambda=0,
    random_state=42,
    verbose=-1,
)

model.fit(X_train_full, y_train_full)

# Predictions for validation set
y_val_pred = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, y_val_pred)

# Print validation metric
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC Score: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Predict on test set
test_preds = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

# Create submission dataframe
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids, "target": test_preds})

# Save submission file
submission_path = "./submission/submission.csv"
submission_df.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {submission_path}")
